title: Legal AI startup Harvey raises $200 million at $11 billion valuation
summary: Harvey, an AI legal company, raised $200 million at a valuation of $11 billion, led by Singapore's GIC and Sequoia. The company, co-founded by Weinberg and Pereyra, offers AI tools for legal services and has over 100,000 users across 1,300 organizations. Harvey is also expanding its AI agents and global legal engineering teams.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights Harvey's significant funding round, its growing user base, and its expansion plans, indicating a positive outlook for the company.
